headline: President Bush changed the rules in an earlier order about the Vice Presidential Service Badge, a military award for service to the Vice President.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 11926, which created the Vice Presidential Service Badge. The badge recognizes members of the armed forces who serve in support of the Vice President. The title does not say exactly what was changed, such as who can earn the badge or how it is awarded.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the armed forces assigned to support the Office of the Vice President
who_it_affects.how: The order changes the rules for the service badge they may receive, though the exact changes are not described in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: The order was signed March 10, 2005. The available material does not state a separate start date.
